text: Legalize your fantasies. Sexual fantasies are a natural play of the mind, the creativity of your sexual energy. Do not be ashamed of them and do not suppress them. Acknowledge their existence, not necessarily embodying them in life. By allowing them to be, you release a huge amount of energy that was locked up by guilt and fear. But still do not become their slave. And understand—when they gently invite you to development, and when they merely decorate the psychological background :)
